entity.name: Shuai Wu
entity.description: Independent open source developer and AI researcher. Sole author and maintainer of Vectaix-AI (Huajuan) and Vectaix-Finance. Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence student at the University of Colorado Boulder, with five papers published on arXiv on multi-model AI systems and their evaluation.

projects.name: Vectaix-AI (Huajuan)
projects.description: Huajuan is a self-hostable agent workspace for planning, tool use, research, document delivery and media creation. It connects to multiple model providers (OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages and Responses APIs), supports shared skills managed through the Skills CLI, and is built with Next.js, React and MongoDB for one-click deployment on Railway. As of November 2026 the repository has 710 stars and 105 forks on GitHub and is under active development by a single maintainer. Funding would cover maintainer time, hosting and infrastructure, and the model API costs of development and testing.
